class_name: 否定-回避-トコロダッタ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: The near-miss counterfactual: the dictionary-form event was on the very brink of happening and then did not, so the sentence usually lands as relief and what it names is typically an unwanted outcome (もう少しで乗り遅れるところだった). The same 〜するところだった also has a merely aspectual reading, "was just on the point of …" with no escape implied; the adverbs もう少しで, あと少しで and 危なく signal the near-miss. とこだった and とこでした are the clipped conversational spellings.

examples.ruby: もう少[すこ]しで電車[でんしゃ]に乗[の]り遅[おく]れるところだった。
examples.english: I very nearly missed my train.

examples.ruby: 危[あぶ]なく母[はは]の誕生日[たんじょうび]を忘[わす]れるところでした。
examples.english: I came within a hair of forgetting my mother's birthday.

examples.ruby: あやうく確認[かくにん]せずに送信[そうしん]するところだった。
examples.english: I very nearly sent it off without checking.
